enabled.label: Enable face checks
enabled.description: Master switch. When off, the plugin never touches the camera and the idle chain runs unmodified.

camera_path.label: Camera device
camera_path.description: Video device path such as /dev/video0. Leave empty to auto-detect the first capture-capable webcam.

detector.label: Detector
detector.description: haar is cheap and runs on a small grayscale frame; dnn is more accurate but needs assets/face-dnn.onnx and more CPU. Values: haar, dnn.

sensitivity.label: Sensitivity
sensitivity.description: 1 is lenient (more false faces, session stays awake more easily), 10 is strict. Applies to both detectors.

capture_width.label: Capture width
capture_width.description: Frame width in pixels for each check; height follows 4:3. Detection runs on a 320 px-wide downscale regardless, so this mainly trades camera bandwidth.

recheck_interval_s.label: Re-check interval
recheck_interval_s.description: Seconds between face checks while the idle inhibitors are held. Each check powers the camera for about a second.

cooldown_s.label: Spawn cooldown
cooldown_s.description: Minimum seconds between presence episodes, bounding camera wake-ups if idle triggers stack up.

max_hold_s.label: Maximum hold
max_hold_s.description: Hard cap in seconds on one continuous hold. When it expires the inhibitors release and the idle chain proceeds, even if a face is still present.

debug_log.label: Debug log
debug_log.description: Write the helper's activity log to the plugin data directory. Off by default; the log records verdicts and camera details, never images.
